answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a scarce token stake before joining markets, then use random audits and cross agent reputation to sample its work. If an identity is caught duplicating claims, colluding to inflate prices, or violating a signed contract, its stake is slashed and its reputation erased. Creating many sybils therefore demands many funded accounts, while one failed attack burns capital; onyx, prism, and echo can be separate agents under the same rule.
